segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so quick pipeline check. The Northstar renewal is at 42 seats, $31,080 annual, target start date is March 1. The CRM is updated, quote is clean, and they’re fine with net 30.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Okay, that one sounds straightforward. Anything blocking it or are we just waiting for them to countersign?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: It’s blocked on the finance approval for the two-month co-term credit. I’ve nudged finance on Monday, again yesterday, and then this morning in the billing channel. They haven’t answered whether the $4,180 credit can be applied on the first invoice, and the customer won’t sign until that answer comes back. So the deal is just sitting stalled even though procurement is ready.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Got it. Is the credit tied to unused seats from the old contract?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Exactly, they dropped from 48 to 42 seats in October but the contract runs through February 28. The pricing sheet supports it, deal desk already said the math is fine, but finance still has to sign off on how it appears on the invoice.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Okay. What about the Pinnacle expansion, the one with the April go-live?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That’s the other one I’m worried about. Pinnacle wants to add 25 seats, $18,750 annual, and they need the security addendum approved before their CIO will release the PO. I’ve been nudging legal every day since last Thursday for that sign-off, plus I forwarded the redline summary twice. Until legal answers, the customer is holding the PO and the deal is stalled. We’re basically parked on a signature page waiting for that one internal yes.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Yeah, that’s frustrating. Commercial terms are otherwise okay?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep. One-year term, standard support, invoice on April 15, no special SLA. They accepted the implementation fee at $3,500 and the success manager has the onboarding dates penciled in for April 22 and 24.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Alright. For forecast, keep Northstar in commit if the invoice treatment lands today, and Pinnacle in best case until that legal item clears.
